description:
General (meta) information elements.
Used for Informationmodel, and other models

ElementId.description:
typed ID unique within the model it is used. The form ist modelname:ID. If the modelname is omitted the ID is defined in the model where it is used.
The part after the : is a shortname of the type of the element

LanguageIso2.description: lowercase iso-2 code of a language

MultilangName.description: Nonempty name, translated into several languages

MultilangText.description: A text of an undefined length and no restriction on characters, translated into several languages

Name.description: Nonempty name  to name somethins not starting or ending in whitespace. Maximum length is 150

Prefix.description: nonempty very short name text used typically as prefixes only letters and numbers and _,-,:,$

ShortName.description: nonempty short text for often used for references. Using letters, digits and ' ',-,:,$,_ Maxlength 15, see also #components/$defs/Name

SomeName.description: Nonempty name with restricted length, either single language or multilingual

SomeText.description: A text of arbitrary length either single language or multilingual

Text.description: Any text in a undefined length
examples: Any text, explaining something with as many characters as needed and any possible character

Uri.description: The URL or URN that uniquely identifies a ressource worldwide.

Urn.title: URN Type Schema
Urn.description: a Uniform Resource Name (URN), as defined inRFC 2141 .

Url.description:
string representing an URL (hhtp, hhtps or file)
[scheme]:[url][:port]//[path]
path elements separated by /. a / in the pathname is replaced by %2F

TechnicalName.description: Nonempty name with restrictd characterset useable for typical programming language names

VersionNo.description: mutlilevel version number with 2-3 dot-sepearted levels
